"No thanks, just take me to the downloads" option. No purchase, account, paid
content, editor extension, or third-party shader was required.

Author: Quaternius. Each archive includes a CC0 1.0 Universal dedication;
the original license text is retained in the corresponding named pack folder.

The downloaded archives stay outside Unity Assets and are not committed. Included
source model/texture bytes are unmodified. Unity import settings configure Humanoid
mapping, clip loops, root-motion policy, normals, mipmaps and a 2048 texture limit.
Our URP materials, cloth mesh, assembled prefabs, controller and scene are separate
under Assets/Art/VillageAudition, VillageProduction and VillageRefinement. Extracted
face meshes, rebound clothing/hair, materials and animation controllers are derived
assets in VillageRefinement, not changes to the downloaded source bytes.
Keep these provenance/license files with the assets
even though CC0 does not require attribution.

Free-edition limits matter: the original anatomical audition is not a final character.
Production combines the separately licensed outfits with heads/hair on a common rig.
The publisher's prepared engine projects and stylized shaders belong to a different
edition; none are included or claimed here. Landscape/path/water shaders and editing
tools in this project are authored locally, not the paid Source edition's tools.
